stem.en:
Gulnora's aunt grows many kinds of fruit in her garden. ______ she has apple, cherry, and apricot trees, as well as two long rows of strawberries.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: For example,
However,
As a result,
Finally,

why.en: The second sentence lists some of the fruit she grows, so it gives examples of the first idea: 'For example,'.
why.uz: Ikkinchi gap u yetishtiradigan mevalardan bir nechtasini sanaydi, yaʼni birinchi fikrga misol keltiradi: «For example,».
why.ru: Второе предложение перечисляет фрукты, которые она выращивает, то есть приводит примеры к первой мысли: «For example,».

stem.en:
The school's new bus is much quieter than the old one. ______ it uses less fuel, which saves the school money every month.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: In addition,
Instead,
For example,
In contrast,

why.en: The second sentence adds another good point about the new bus, so the link is addition: 'In addition,'.
why.uz: Ikkinchi gap yangi avtobusning yana bir yaxshi tomonini qoʻshadi, demak bogʻlanish qoʻshish: «In addition,».
why.ru: Второе предложение добавляет ещё одно достоинство нового автобуса, значит, связь — добавление: «In addition,».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.

instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
On Saturday morning, Nilufar painted the walls of the new classroom a pale green. ______ her brother put together the bookshelves in the hallway outside, so that both jobs were done by lunch.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Meanwhile,
As a result,
For example,
In conclusion,

why.en: The two jobs happen at the same time, and both are done by lunch. 'Meanwhile,' shows actions at the same time.
why.uz: Ikki ish bir vaqtda bajariladi va tushlikkacha ikkalasi ham tugaydi. «Meanwhile,» bir vaqtdagi harakatlarni koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Две работы идут одновременно, и обе готовы к обеду. «Meanwhile,» показывает действия в одно и то же время.

instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Many students expected the school's new rule against phones at lunch to be unpopular. ______ when the student council asked them a month later, most said they now enjoyed talking with friends at the table.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: However,
Therefore,
For instance,
Similarly,

why.en: Students expected to dislike the rule but came to like it. The outcome is the opposite of the expectation, so 'However,' fits.
why.uz: Oʻquvchilar qoidani yoqtirmaymiz deb kutgan, lekin keyin yoqtirib qolgan. Natija kutilganning aksi, shuning uchun «However,» mos.
why.ru: Ученики ждали, что правило им не понравится, а оно понравилось. Итог противоположен ожиданию, поэтому подходит «However,».

instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Kamola expected the long train ride to her grandparents' town to be dull, so she packed three thick novels. As it turned out, the novels stayed in her bag the whole way. ______ she spent the journey talking with an elderly couple who had worked as tour guides for forty years and had a story about every station they passed.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Instead,
Likewise,
For example,
Even so,

why.en: She did not read; she talked. The second action takes the place of the one she planned, so 'Instead,' fits.
why.uz: U kitob oʻqimadi, suhbatlashdi. Ikkinchi harakat rejadagi harakatning oʻrnini egallaydi, shuning uchun «Instead,» mos.
why.ru: Она не читала, а разговаривала. Второе действие заменяет задуманное, поэтому подходит «Instead,».

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The school's spring concert will be held on 22 April.
• It will start at 5 p.m.
• It will take place in the assembly hall.
• The school choir and the dance club will perform.

The student wants to tell readers which groups will perform at the concert.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The school choir and the dance club will perform at the spring concert.
On 22 April, the school's spring concert will be held in the assembly hall, starting at 5 p.m.
The spring concert will take place in the school's assembly hall.
The school's spring concert will start at 5 p.m. on 22 April.

why.en: The goal asks which groups will perform. Only the choice naming the school choir and the dance club answers it; the others give the time or the place.
why.uz: Maqsad qaysi guruhlar chiqishini soʻraydi. Faqat maktab xori va raqs toʻgaragini aytgan javob shunga javob beradi; qolganlari vaqt yoki joyni aytadi.
why.ru: Цель — назвать группы, которые выступят. Отвечает только вариант про школьный хор и танцевальный кружок; остальные дают время или место.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Otabek's family runs a small shop that sells dried fruit.
• The shop opens at 7 a.m.
• Many customers work at a factory nearby.
• Otabek's father opens early so that these workers can shop before their shift begins.

The student wants to explain why the shop opens early.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Otabek's father opens the shop at 7 a.m. so that factory workers can shop before their shift.
Otabek's family runs a small shop that sells dried fruit, and many of its customers work at a factory nearby.
Many of the shop's customers work at a factory near the shop.
The family's dried-fruit shop opens its doors to customers at 7 a.m.

why.en: An explanation needs the reason. Only the choice with 'so that factory workers can shop before their shift' says why the shop opens at 7 a.m.
why.uz: Tushuntirish uchun sabab kerak. Faqat «so that factory workers can shop before their shift» qismli javob doʻkon nega soat 7 da ochilishini aytadi.
why.ru: Для объяснения нужна причина. Только ответ с «so that factory workers can shop before their shift» говорит, почему магазин открывается в 7 утра.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Two students built model bridges for a contest.
• Jahongir's bridge was made of wooden sticks.
• Sevara's bridge was made of paper straws.
• Each bridge held 12 kilograms before it broke.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two bridges.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Although they were made of different materials, both bridges held 12 kilograms before breaking.
For the contest, Jahongir built his model bridge from wooden sticks, while Sevara built hers from paper straws.
Sevara's model bridge, made of paper straws, held 12 kilograms before it broke.
Jahongir's bridge was made of wooden sticks, a stronger material than paper straws.

why.en: A similarity must hold for both bridges. Only 'both bridges held 12 kilograms' states what they share; another choice stresses a difference.
why.uz: Oʻxshashlik ikkala koʻprik uchun ham toʻgʻri boʻlishi kerak. Umumiy jihatni faqat «both bridges held 12 kilograms» aytadi; boshqa javob farqni taʼkidlaydi.
why.ru: Сходство должно касаться обоих мостов. Общее называет только «both bridges held 12 kilograms»; другой вариант подчёркивает различие.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A book swap shelf stands at the entrance of the town hospital.
• Visitors leave a book they have finished and take a different one.
• No money is paid, and nobody signs anything.
• A student volunteer group built the shelf.

The student wants to explain how the shelf works to readers who have never seen one.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: At the hospital's book swap shelf, visitors leave a book they have finished and take another, without paying or signing anything.
A student volunteer group built the book swap shelf that now stands at the entrance of the town hospital.
The book swap shelf at the town hospital has become popular with patients and their families.
There is a book swap shelf at the entrance of the town hospital.

why.en: Readers who have never seen a swap shelf need to know how it works. Only the choice saying visitors leave a book and take another, for free, explains it.
why.uz: Bunday javonni koʻrmagan oʻquvchiga u qanday ishlashi kerak. Buni faqat kitob qoldirib, boshqasini bepul olish haqidagi javob tushuntiradi.
why.ru: Читателю, который не видел такую полку, нужно знать, как она работает. Это объясняет только ответ: оставь прочитанную книгу и бесплатно возьми другую.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A class tested whether music helps bean plants grow.
• For 30 days, ten plants grew with music playing and ten grew in silence.
• The plants with music grew an average of 2 centimeters taller.
• The two groups were kept in different rooms, which got different amounts of sunlight.

The student wants to present the result while noting a reason to doubt that music caused it.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The plants with music grew 2 centimeters taller on average, but the two groups also got different amounts of sunlight.
After 30 days, the bean plants that grew with music were an average of 2 centimeters taller than the plants grown in silence.
Because the two groups of plants were kept in different rooms, they did not get the same amount of sunlight.
The class found that music helps bean plants grow taller than plants kept in silence.

why.en: The goal has two parts: the result and a doubt. Only the choice joining '2 centimeters taller' with 'different amounts of sunlight' gives both.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki qismli: natija va shubha. Ikkalasini faqat «2 centimeters taller» va «different amounts of sunlight» ni birlashtirgan javob beradi.
why.ru: У цели две части: результат и сомнение. Обе даёт только ответ, где «2 centimeters taller» соединено с «different amounts of sunlight».

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
For years, fruit sellers at the town market threw away bruised apricots at the end of each day. Two summers ago, a local cook began buying the bruised fruit at a low price to make jam. ______ the sellers now waste far less fruit, and the cook's jam is sold in three shops in town.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: As a result,
Nevertheless,
Previously,
For instance,

why.en: The blank follows the cook buying the bruised fruit, which cut the waste. The link is result: 'As a result,'. 'Nevertheless' answers the first sentence instead.
why.uz: Boʻsh joy oshpaz ezilgan mevani sotib ola boshlaganidan keyin keladi, bu isrofni kamaytirgan. Bogʻlanish natija: «As a result,». «Nevertheless» esa birinchi gapga javob beradi.
why.ru: Пропуск идёт после того, как повар стал покупать мятые фрукты, и это сократило отходы. Связь — результат: «As a result,». «Nevertheless» отвечает первому предложению.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
The city's new bus timetable has drawn complaints from riders in the western districts, whose morning buses now come every twenty minutes instead of every ten. ______ the change has shortened waiting times for most riders in the city, because the buses taken off the western routes now serve the crowded central lines.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Even so,
Therefore,
In other words,
Likewise,

why.en: The text first admits a problem, then says the change helps most riders anyway. 'Even so,' brings in a point that holds despite the one before it.
why.uz: Matn avval muammoni tan oladi, keyin oʻzgarish baribir koʻpchilikka foyda berishini aytadi. «Even so,» oldingi fikrga qaramay toʻgʻri boʻlgan fikrni boshlaydi.
why.ru: Текст сначала признаёт проблему, затем говорит, что перемены всё же помогают большинству. «Even so,» вводит мысль, верную вопреки предыдущей.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Before the final match, the coach told her team that the game would be won "in the last ten minutes, not the first." ______ she wanted the players to save their energy early in the match so that they could run harder at the end.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: In other words,
In contrast,
As an example,
Even so,

why.en: The second sentence says the coach's words again, more plainly. 'In other words,' brings in a restatement of the same idea.
why.uz: Ikkinchi gap murabbiyning soʻzlarini soddaroq qilib qayta aytadi. «In other words,» oʻsha fikrni boshqacha ifodalashni boshlaydi.
why.ru: Второе предложение проще пересказывает слова тренера. «In other words,» вводит ту же мысль другими словами.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
The history museum's new guide app was designed with its youngest visitors in mind. ______ it lets children collect a digital stamp at each of twelve exhibits and unlock a short puzzle game once they have all twelve.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Specifically,
Nonetheless,
Previously,
In contrast,

why.en: The second sentence gives the exact features that make the app right for children. 'Specifically,' moves from a general claim to its details.
why.uz: Ikkinchi gap ilovani bolalarga mos qiladigan aniq imkoniyatlarni beradi. «Specifically,» umumiy fikrdan uning tafsilotlariga oʻtadi.
why.ru: Второе предложение называет конкретные функции, из-за которых приложение подходит детям. «Specifically,» ведёт от общего к деталям.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
In the old quarter of the city, many houses were built around a shaded courtyard that kept the rooms cool through the summer. ______ the architect of the new school placed its classrooms around an open garden planted with tall trees, so that the rooms would stay cool without much air conditioning.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Likewise,
However,
Granted,
In conclusion,

why.en: Both the old houses and the new school are built around a shaded open space to stay cool. The second idea matches the first, so 'Likewise,' fits.
why.uz: Eski uylar ham, yangi maktab ham salqin boʻlishi uchun soyali ochiq joy atrofida qurilgan. Ikkinchi fikr birinchisiga oʻxshaydi, shuning uchun «Likewise,» mos.
why.ru: И старые дома, и новая школа построены вокруг тенистого открытого места, чтобы было прохладно. Мысли похожи, поэтому подходит «Likewise,».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
At the regional contest, the school robotics team's machine was slower than most of the others, and it dropped two of its five blocks. ______ the judges gave it the design award, praising its simple frame, which the students had built from old bicycle parts.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Nonetheless,
Accordingly,
For example,
Similarly,

why.en: A slow robot that dropped blocks would not be expected to win an award, yet it did. 'Nonetheless,' shows an outcome that goes against the facts before it.
why.uz: Sekin va bloklarni tushirgan robot mukofot olishi kutilmasdi, lekin oldi. «Nonetheless,» oldingi faktlarga zid natijani koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: От медленного робота, ронявшего блоки, награды не ждали, но он её получил. «Nonetheless,» показывает итог вопреки фактам перед ним.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Today, students at the school choose their own seats in the library, and the librarian says the room is busier than it has ever been. ______ each class was assigned a fixed table, and a student who sat anywhere else was asked to move.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Previously,
Moreover,
Therefore,
For instance,

why.en: The first sentence says 'Today'; the second describes an older rule that no longer holds. 'Previously,' moves the text back in time.
why.uz: Birinchi gap «Today» deydi; ikkinchisi endi amalda boʻlmagan eski qoidani tasvirlaydi. «Previously,» matnni oʻtmishga qaytaradi.
why.ru: Первое предложение говорит «Today»; второе описывает старое правило, которое уже не действует. «Previously,» переносит текст в прошлое.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Dilbar's grandfather never seemed to mind the long walk to the village market. ______ he often took the even longer path along the river, saying that the extra twenty minutes were the best part of his day.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: In fact,
However,
As a result,
Otherwise,

why.en: The second sentence goes further than the first: he did not just accept the long walk, he made it longer. 'In fact,' adds this stronger point.
why.uz: Ikkinchi gap birinchisidan kuchliroq: u uzoq yoʻlga nafaqat qarshi boʻlmagan, balki uni yana uzaytirgan. «In fact,» shu kuchliroq fikrni qoʻshadi.
why.ru: Второе предложение сильнее первого: он не только не возражал против долгой дороги, но и удлинял её. «In fact,» добавляет эту более сильную мысль.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
For almost a year, the town council argued over a plan to turn the empty factory into a sports hall. Some members wanted to sell the building; others worried about the cost of repairing its roof. ______ the council voted eight to three to build the hall, and work began the following spring.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: In the end,
For instance,
Similarly,
In other words,

why.en: After a long debate comes the final decision. 'In the end,' marks the outcome that closes a long process.
why.uz: Uzoq bahsdan keyin yakuniy qaror keladi. «In the end,» uzoq jarayonni yakunlagan natijani bildiradi.
why.ru: После долгого спора приходит окончательное решение. «In the end,» отмечает итог долгого процесса.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Nodir's first short film followed one family through an entire year and ran for almost an hour. His second film, ______ covers a single afternoon in a barbershop and lasts just twelve minutes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: by contrast,
for example,
as a result,
similarly,

why.en: The first film covers a year and runs almost an hour; the second covers one afternoon and runs twelve minutes. They are opposite, so 'by contrast,' fits.
why.uz: Birinchi film bir yilni qamraydi va bir soatga yaqin davom etadi; ikkinchisi bir necha soatni qamraydi va 12 daqiqa. Ular qarama-qarshi, shuning uchun «by contrast,» mos.
why.ru: Первый фильм охватывает год и идёт почти час, второй — несколько часов одного дня и идёт 12 минут. Они противоположны, поэтому подходит «by contrast,».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Two student teams designed water filters for a regional science fair.
• Team Lola's filter uses layers of sand and charcoal inside a plastic bottle.
• It is meant for families who collect rainwater.
• Team Bahrom's filter uses a cloth bag and sunlight.
• It is meant for hikers who need clean water quickly.

The student wants to emphasize a difference in who each filter is meant for.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Team Lola's filter is meant for families who collect rainwater, whereas Team Bahrom's is meant for hikers who need clean water quickly.
Team Lola's filter layers sand and charcoal inside a plastic bottle, while Team Bahrom's relies on nothing more than a cloth bag and sunlight.
Team Bahrom designed a filter, made from a cloth bag and sunlight, for hikers who need clean water quickly.
Two student teams designed water filters for a regional science fair, each using different materials.

why.en: The goal is a difference in users. Only the choice setting families who collect rainwater against hikers compares who; another compares materials.
why.uz: Maqsad foydalanuvchilardagi farq. Faqat yomgʻir suvini yigʻadigan oilalarni sayyohlarga qarshi qoʻygan javob kim uchunligini solishtiradi; boshqasi materiallarni solishtiradi.
why.ru: Цель — различие в том, для кого фильтр. Это сравнивает только ответ, где семьи с дождевой водой противопоставлены туристам; другой сравнивает материалы.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• In a school survey, students named the quiet hour as the change they liked most this year.
• During the quiet hour, from 2 to 3 p.m. on Wednesdays, the whole school reads silently.
• Teachers read too.
• Students said it was the only time in the week when no one checked a phone.

The student wants to introduce the quiet hour to readers outside the school and explain why students like it.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Every Wednesday from 2 to 3 p.m., the whole school, teachers included, reads in silence, and students like this quiet hour because no one checks a phone.
In a school survey, students named the quiet hour as the change that they liked most this year.
During the quiet hour, from 2 to 3 p.m. on Wednesdays, everyone at the school reads silently, including the teachers.
Students said that the quiet hour was the only time in the week when no one checked a phone.

why.en: The goal has two parts: what the quiet hour is and why students like it. Only the choice ending 'because no one checks a phone' also says what it is.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki qismli: «quiet hour» nima va oʻquvchilarga nega yoqadi. Faqat «because no one checks a phone» bilan tugagan javob uning nimaligini ham aytadi.
why.ru: У цели две части: что такое quiet hour и почему он нравится ученикам. Только ответ, который кончается на «because no one checks a phone», говорит и что это.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Sarbon's spring fair began in 1998 as a way for farmers to sell seedlings.
• Oqbuloq's autumn fair began in 2005 as a way for craftspeople to sell pottery.
• Both fairs are now run entirely by volunteers.
• Both give all their profits to the local school.

The student wants to emphasize what the two fairs have in common today.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Today, both fairs are run entirely by volunteers and give all their profits to the local school.
Sarbon's fair began in 1998 to help farmers sell seedlings, while Oqbuloq's began in 2005 for craftspeople selling pottery.
Both fairs began as a way for local people to sell goods: seedlings in Sarbon and pottery in Oqbuloq.
Oqbuloq's autumn fair is run entirely by volunteers and gives all of its profits to the local school.

why.en: The goal asks what the fairs share today. Only the choice about volunteers and profits for the school does that; another shares their beginnings, not today.
why.uz: Maqsad yarmarkalarning bugungi umumiy jihatini soʻraydi. Buni faqat koʻngillilar va maktabga foyda haqidagi javob beradi; boshqasi bugunni emas, boshlanishini aytadi.
why.ru: Цель — что общего у ярмарок сегодня. Это даёт только ответ про волонтёров и доход для школы; другой говорит о начале, а не о сегодняшнем дне.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Last year, the school garden produced 40 kilograms of tomatoes.
• This year, it produced only 15 kilograms.
• In June, a hailstorm damaged most of the young tomato plants.
• The cucumbers, planted later in July, were not harmed.

The student wants to explain why the tomato harvest fell.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The tomato harvest fell from 40 to 15 kilograms because a June hailstorm damaged most of the young plants.
The school garden produced 40 kilograms of tomatoes last year but only 15 kilograms this year.
Because they were planted later, in July, the cucumbers in the school garden were not harmed by June's hailstorm.
A hailstorm in June damaged most of the young tomato plants in the school garden.

why.en: Explaining the fall needs both the fall and its cause. Only the choice linking 40 to 15 kilograms with the June hailstorm gives both.
why.uz: Pasayishni tushuntirish uchun ham pasayish, ham uning sababi kerak. Ikkalasini faqat 40 dan 15 kilogrammga tushishni iyundagi doʻl bilan bogʻlagan javob beradi.
why.ru: Чтобы объяснить спад, нужны и спад, и его причина. Обе части есть только в ответе, где падение с 40 до 15 кг связано с июньским градом.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The town library recorded when different groups visit.
• Students fill the reading room from 3 to 6 p.m. on school days.
• Retired readers come mostly from 9 to 11 a.m.
• Parents with small children come mostly on Saturday mornings.

The student wants to make a general statement about how the library is used.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Each group has its own hours at the library: afternoons for students, mornings for retired readers, and Saturdays for parents.
On school days, students fill the library's reading room from 3 p.m. until 6 p.m.
The library recorded when different groups visit and found that the reading room is full in the afternoons.
Retired readers visit the town library mostly from 9 to 11 a.m., when it is quiet.

why.en: A general statement covers the whole pattern, not one group. Only the choice giving different hours for students, retired readers and parents does that.
why.uz: Umumiy fikr bitta guruhni emas, butun manzarani qamraydi. Buni faqat oʻquvchilar, nafaqadagilar va ota-onalar uchun turli vaqtni aytgan javob qiladi.
why.ru: Общее утверждение охватывает всю картину, а не одну группу. Это делает только ответ с разным временем для учеников, пенсионеров и родителей.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Mohira, a 16-year-old student, taught herself to repair old radios.
• Since 2024, she has repaired 37 radios for her neighbors.
• She charges nothing for her work.
• In return, neighbors sometimes give her spare parts.

The student wants to emphasize Mohira's generosity.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Mohira has repaired 37 radios for her neighbors without charging them anything for her work.
Mohira, who is only 16 years old, taught herself to repair old radios and has fixed 37 of them since 2024.
Mohira's neighbors sometimes give her spare parts, which she uses to repair old radios.
Since 2024, Mohira has become skilled enough to repair almost any old radio she is given.

why.en: Generosity means giving without asking for payment. Only the choice saying she repaired 37 radios without charging anything shows it.
why.uz: Saxiylik haq soʻramay berishdir. Buni faqat u 37 ta radioni hech qanday haq olmay tuzatganini aytgan javob koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Щедрость — это отдавать, не прося платы. Её показывает только ответ о том, что она починила 37 радио, ничего не взяв за работу.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A class tested three bags for keeping bread fresh over 7 days.
• Bread in a paper bag stayed soft for 2 days.
• Bread in a cloth bag stayed soft for 4 days.
• Bread in a plastic bag stayed soft for 5 days, but mold appeared on day 6.
• No mold appeared in the paper or cloth bags.

The student wants to make the case for the cloth bag.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Plastic kept bread soft one day longer, but mold grew in it; the cloth bag kept bread soft for 4 days with no mold.
Of the three bags the class tested, the plastic bag kept bread soft the longest, for 5 days.
No mold appeared on the bread kept in the paper bag or in the cloth bag during the 7-day test.
Over 7 days, the class tested paper, cloth, and plastic bags to find out which of the three kept bread soft and fresh the longest.

why.en: To make the case for cloth, answer its strongest rival: plastic lasts longer but grows mold. Only the choice setting plastic's mold against cloth's 4 days does that.
why.uz: Mato xalta foydasiga dalil uchun eng kuchli raqibga javob berish kerak: plastik uzoqroq saqlaydi, lekin mogʻor bosadi. Buni faqat shu ikkisini solishtirgan javob qiladi.
why.ru: Чтобы доказать пользу ткани, нужно ответить сильнейшему сопернику: пластик дольше, но плесневеет. Это делает только ответ, где плесень сравнена с 4 днями ткани.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A school club expected students to prefer the new online homework system.
• The club predicted that at least 150 of 200 students would choose the online system.
• In a poll of 200 students, 120 preferred paper homework.
• The most common reason given was that paper homework is easier to do without a phone.

The student wants to emphasize that the result surprised the club.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The club predicted that at least 150 of 200 students would choose online homework, yet 120 chose paper.
In a poll of 200 students, 120 preferred paper homework, mostly because it is easier to do without a phone.
A school club asked 200 students whether they preferred the new online homework system or paper homework.
Most students who preferred paper homework said that it is easier to do without a phone.

why.en: A surprise is a gap between what was expected and what happened. Only the choice setting the prediction of 150 against the 120 who chose paper shows it.
why.uz: Kutilmagan natija kutilgan va boʻlgan narsa orasidagi farqdir. Buni faqat 150 degan bashoratni qogʻozni tanlagan 120 kishiga qarshi qoʻygan javob koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Неожиданность — это разрыв между ожиданием и итогом. Его показывает только ответ, где прогноз в 150 человек противопоставлен 120, выбравшим бумагу.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The art club makes its own paper from old newspapers.
• First, members tear the newspapers into small pieces.
• Next, they soak the pieces in water overnight.
• Then they blend the wet pieces into a pulp and spread it thinly on a screen.
• The pulp dries in the sun into a new sheet.

The student wants to describe the steps in the order in which the club does them.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The club tears old newspapers into pieces, soaks them overnight, blends them into a pulp, and spreads the pulp on a screen to dry.
The art club makes new sheets of paper out of old newspapers, which it dries in the sun on a screen.
Members blend wet newspaper into a pulp after spreading it thinly on a screen and soaking it overnight.
Before the art club soaks old newspapers in water overnight, members tear them into small pieces.

why.en: The goal is the steps in order: tear, soak, blend, spread and dry. Only the choice that begins 'The club tears old newspapers' keeps every step in that order.
why.uz: Maqsad bosqichlarni tartib bilan berish: yirtish, ivitish, ezish, yoyish, quritish. Hammasini shu tartibda faqat «The club tears old newspapers» bilan boshlangan javob beradi.
why.ru: Цель — шаги по порядку: порвать, замочить, измельчить, разложить, высушить. Все шаги в этом порядке даёт только ответ, который начинается с «The club tears old newspapers».

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A student proposes that the school replace its paper notice board with a screen.
• A screen costs more to buy than a board.
• A screen can show each notice in three languages, one after another.
• Notices on the paper board are often covered by newer ones.

The student wants to acknowledge a drawback of the proposal and then argue for it.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Although a screen costs more to buy than a paper board, it can show every notice in three languages.
A screen can show notices in three languages, while notices on the paper board are often covered by newer ones.
A screen costs more to buy than a paper board, which is why the school should keep its board.
A student has proposed that the school replace its paper notice board with a screen.

why.en: The goal is a drawback, then a case for the screen. Only the choice that admits the cost and then gives the three languages does both; one argues against it.
why.uz: Maqsad avval kamchilikni, keyin ekran foydasiga dalilni berish. Ikkalasini faqat narxni tan olib, keyin uch tilni aytgan javob qiladi; bittasi esa ekranga qarshi.
why.ru: Цель — сначала недостаток, потом довод за экран. Обе части даёт только ответ, который признаёт цену, а затем называет три языка; один вариант против экрана.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
Sherzod, who owns a small café near a train station, put up a new menu in three languages on the café's door. He claims that the new menu has brought more travelers into the café.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Sherzod's claim?

options.en: In the month after the new menu went up, the number of travelers eating at the café doubled.
Sherzod paid a local artist to paint the new menu on the door.
Most of the café's regular customers live within walking distance of it.
The café serves the same dishes that it served before the new menu went up.

why.en: The claim links the menu to more travelers coming in. Only the finding that travelers doubled after the menu went up shows that.
why.uz: Daʼvo menyuni koʻproq yoʻlovchi kelishi bilan bogʻlaydi. Buni faqat menyu osilgach yoʻlovchilar ikki barobar koʻpaygani haqidagi natija koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Утверждение связывает меню с ростом числа путешественников. Это показывает только результат: после нового меню их стало вдвое больше.

instructions.en: Choose the quotation or finding that best supports the claim in the text.
instructions.uz: Matndagi fikrni eng yaxshi tasdiqlaydigan iqtibos yoki natijani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите цитату или результат, который лучше всего подтверждает утверждение в тексте.

stem.en:
Members of a school's reading club recorded how many minutes each of three groups read during one week.

Group | Minutes read
Group A | 340
Group B | 415
Group C | 290

The club leader concluded that Group B read for more minutes than either of the other groups.

Which choice best describes data from the table that support the leader's conclusion?

options.en: Group B read for 415 minutes, more than Group A (340) or Group C (290).
Group A read for 340 minutes, and Group C read for 290 minutes.
Group C read for fewer minutes than either Group A or Group B.
Group A read for 415 minutes, more than either of the other two groups.

why.en: The conclusion is that Group B read the most. Only 'Group B read for 415 minutes, more than Group A (340) or Group C (290)' is accurate and on point.
why.uz: Xulosa B guruh eng koʻp oʻqigani haqida. Faqat «Group B read for 415 minutes, more than Group A (340) or Group C (290)» ham aniq, ham xulosaga tegishli.
why.ru: Вывод — что группа B читала дольше всех. Только «Group B read for 415 minutes, more than Group A (340) or Group C (290)» точен и по делу.

instructions.en: Read the text and the table. Choose the answer that uses the data correctly.
instructions.uz: Matn va jadvalni oʻqing. Maʼlumotlardan toʻgʻri foydalangan javobni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте текст и таблицу. Выберите ответ, в котором данные использованы верно.

stem.en:
In a short story, the narrator describes her neighbor Rano as a very patient person.

Which quotation from the story most effectively illustrates the narrator's description?

options.en: "When my little brother asked her the same question for the fifth time, Rano answered it as calmly as she had the first time."
"Rano grew roses along her fence, red ones on one side and white ones on the other."
"Every morning at seven, Rano left the house for her job at the post office."
"Rano laughed so loudly at our jokes that the people sitting outside the café across the street all turned around to look at her."

why.en: Patience means staying calm when something is repeated or slow. Only the quotation where Rano answers the fifth question as calmly as the first shows it.
why.uz: Sabr biror narsa takrorlansa ham xotirjam qolishdir. Buni faqat Rano beshinchi savolga ham birinchisidek xotirjam javob bergan iqtibos koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Терпение — это спокойствие, даже когда что-то повторяется. Его показывает только цитата, где Рано отвечает на пятый вопрос так же спокойно, как на первый.

instructions.en: Choose the quotation or finding that best supports the claim in the text.
instructions.uz: Matndagi fikrni eng yaxshi tasdiqlaydigan iqtibos yoki natijani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите цитату или результат, который лучше всего подтверждает утверждение в тексте.

stem.en:
A student recorded the points two teams scored in three rounds of a school quiz.

Round | Team Lochin | Team Burgut
1 | 45 | 70
2 | 60 | 72
3 | 80 | 75

The student claims that although Team Burgut scored more points at first, Team Lochin improved enough to outscore it by round 3.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the student's claim?

options.en: Team Lochin scored 45 points to Team Burgut's 70 in round 1, but 80 to Team Burgut's 75 in round 3.
Team Burgut scored between 70 and 75 points in each of the three rounds.
Team Lochin scored more points in round 3 than it did in round 1.
Team Lochin scored 70 points in round 1 and 75 points in round 3.

why.en: The claim has two parts: Burgut ahead at first, Lochin ahead by round 3. Only the choice comparing both teams in rounds 1 and 3 shows both.
why.uz: Daʼvo ikki qismli: avval Burgut oldinda, 3-raundda esa Lochin. Ikkalasini faqat ikki jamoani 1- va 3-raundda solishtirgan javob koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: У утверждения две части: сначала впереди Burgut, к 3-му раунду — Lochin. Обе показывает только ответ, где команды сравнены в раундах 1 и 3.

instructions.en: Read the text and the table. Choose the answer that uses the data correctly.
instructions.uz: Matn va jadvalni oʻqing. Maʼlumotlardan toʻgʻri foydalangan javobni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте текст и таблицу. Выберите ответ, в котором данные использованы верно.

stem.en:
Gulbahor, a school librarian, noticed that students who joined the library's audiobook program borrowed more printed books than other students did. She concluded that listening to audiobooks makes students want to read more printed books.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken Gulbahor's conclusion?

options.en: Students who joined the audiobook program had already borrowed more printed books than other students before they joined.
The audiobook program was started three years ago with money from a local business.
Students in the audiobook program listened to an average of three audiobooks each month.
After joining the audiobook program, students borrowed even more printed books than before.

why.en: If program students already borrowed more printed books before joining, audiobooks cannot be the cause. That finding weakens the conclusion most directly.
why.uz: Agar dastur oʻquvchilari qoʻshilishdan oldin ham koʻproq kitob olgan boʻlsa, sabab audiokitob boʻla olmaydi. Bu natija xulosani eng toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri zaiflashtiradi.
why.ru: Если ученики и до программы брали больше печатных книг, причина не в аудиокнигах. Этот результат ослабляет вывод напрямую.

instructions.en: Choose the finding that most weakens the conclusion in the text.
instructions.uz: Matndagi xulosani eng koʻp zaiflashtiradigan natijani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите результат, который сильнее всего ослабляет вывод в тексте.

stem.en:
A student asked classmates how they traveled to school in winter and in spring.

Way of travel | Winter | Spring
Bus | 14 | 8
Walk | 9 | 12
Bicycle | 1 | 6
Car | 6 | 4

The student claims that when the weather got warmer in spring, fewer classmates took the bus, while more walked or rode a bicycle.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the student's claim?

options.en: Bus riders fell from 14 to 8, while walkers rose from 9 to 12 and cyclists from 1 to 6.
The number of classmates who came by car fell from 6 in winter to 4 in spring.
In winter, more classmates took the bus than used any other way of travel.
Walkers rose from 9 to 12, while bus riders rose from 8 to 14.

why.en: The claim has two parts: fewer bus riders and more walkers and cyclists. Only the choice with the bus falling from 14 to 8 and both rises shows both.
why.uz: Daʼvo ikki qismli: avtobusda yuruvchilar kamaygan, piyoda va velosipedda yuruvchilar koʻpaygan. Ikkalasini faqat avtobus 14 dan 8 ga tushgan va ikki oʻsish bor javob beradi.
why.ru: У утверждения две части: меньше ездят на автобусе, больше ходят пешком и на велосипеде. Обе даёт только ответ: автобус с 14 до 8 и оба роста.

instructions.en: Read the text and the table. Choose the answer that uses the data correctly.
instructions.uz: Matn va jadvalni oʻqing. Maʼlumotlardan toʻgʻri foydalangan javobni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте текст и таблицу. Выберите ответ, в котором данные использованы верно.

stem.en:
In a poem, the speaker returns to her village after years in a large city. A student claims that the speaker feels both relief at being home and regret for what she has left behind.

Which quotation from the poem most effectively illustrates the student's claim?

options.en: "I breathe the apricot air and sleep at last, / though some nights I still listen for the trams."
"The city's towers rose like a forest of glass / where no one ever learned my name."
"My mother's gate still creaks the way it did, / and the same dog barks at the same hour."
"How small the school looks now, how short the road / that once took me a whole morning to walk."

why.en: The claim needs two feelings. 'Sleep at last' shows relief at home, and still listening for the trams shows she misses the city. Only this quotation has both.
why.uz: Daʼvoga ikki tuygʻu kerak. «Sleep at last» uydagi yengillikni, tramvaylarni hamon tinglashi esa shaharni sogʻinishini koʻrsatadi. Ikkalasi faqat shu iqtibosda.
why.ru: Нужны два чувства. «Sleep at last» — облегчение дома, а то, что она всё ещё ждёт звука трамваев, — тоска по городу. Оба есть только в этой цитате.

instructions.en: Choose the quotation or finding that best supports the claim in the text.
instructions.uz: Matndagi fikrni eng yaxshi tasdiqlaydigan iqtibos yoki natijani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите цитату или результат, который лучше всего подтверждает утверждение в тексте.

stem.en:
Three school clubs collected books for a village library.

Club | Members | Books collected
Chess | 12 | 96
Drama | 30 | 150
Science | 20 | 120

The chess club's leader claims that although his club collected the fewest books, its members collected the most books per member.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the leader's claim?

options.en: The chess club collected 96 books, the fewest, but that is 8 per member, compared with 5 for drama and 6 for science.
The drama club, with 30 members, collected 150 books, more than either of the other two clubs.
The chess club has the fewest members of the three clubs, only 12, compared with 30 and 20.
The science club collected 120 books, which is 6 books for each of its 20 members.

why.en: The claim is about books per member: 96 ÷ 12 = 8, 150 ÷ 30 = 5 and 120 ÷ 20 = 6. Only the choice with all three rates supports it.
why.uz: Daʼvo bir aʼzoga toʻgʻri keladigan kitoblar haqida: 96 ÷ 12 = 8, 150 ÷ 30 = 5, 120 ÷ 20 = 6. Faqat uchala koʻrsatkichni bergan javob uni tasdiqlaydi.
why.ru: Речь о книгах на одного участника: 96 ÷ 12 = 8, 150 ÷ 30 = 5, 120 ÷ 20 = 6. Утверждение подтверждает только ответ со всеми тремя числами.

instructions.en: Read the text and the table. Choose the answer that uses the data correctly.
instructions.uz: Matn va jadvalni oʻqing. Maʼlumotlardan toʻgʻri foydalangan javobni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте текст и таблицу. Выберите ответ, в котором данные использованы верно.
